caption: The drawing consists of three bell-shaped flowers with curving petals and elongated stems, rendered in blue pencil or crayon on a tan or brownish background. The flowers have shading, with darker blue at the tips and along some edges and veins. There are several thin, curling stems and stylized leaves that extend from the base of the flower cluster. Above the flowers, in the upper half of the image, there is a line of hand-drawn text in block letters, reading “W.A. [indistinct text] S. LITTLE 12TH ST. NEW YORK,” which appears to be stamped or written. The number “3” is written centrally above the text at the top. The lower right corner contains the name “John Tarantino,” written in small letters.
